law_name: Law No. 154 on the Copyright of the Author and the Performing Artist (2022)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years after death (art. 72); anonymous or pseudonymous works 50 years from disclosure (art. 73.1); photographs and applied art 25 years from creation (art. 75)
moral_rights: Moral rights (facultades de carácter moral) of authors (art. 17: attribution, disclosure, integrity, modification, withdrawal from circulation) and of performers (art. 18)
digital_protection: Art. 71: a technological measure or contractual agreement that circumvents the limits on economic rights is unlawful; no protection of technological measures for rightholders was found
fair_use_exceptions: Non-profit libraries and archives may copy works from permanent collections to preserve or replace them; other exceptions not seen (unconfirmed)
enforcement_body: National Copyright Centre (CENDA; created by Decree 20 of 21 Feb 1978)
notes: Replaces Law No. 14 of 28 December 1977 and Decree-Law No. 156 of 1994, repealed by the third final provision (Gaceta Oficial GOC-2022-1103-O122, approved 16 May 2022); orphan works, enforcement body and exceptions not rechecked against the new text. Berne accession 20 Nov 1996, in force 20 Feb 1997 (excludes Art. 33(1) ICJ clause); not-party to WCT/WPPT inferred from absence in WIPO Lex country list; WTO membership from member lists; 2006 draft decree-law to update the regime, status unknown
